description_expanded:
This beautiful home features a very convenient location between the Caliza pool complex and ZUMA Wellness Center, and just a short walk to the emerging Town Center. The private courtyard features an outdoor dining area with a fountain, gas grill and an outdoor fireplace for relaxation. The first floor offers an open-plan great room with gas fireplace, dining area and kitchen with a large center island. Also, conveniently found on the first floor is a king bedroom with an ensuite bathroom. As you ascend to the second floor, you will find a bunk room with 4 total beds (2 upper, 2 lower). The bunk room shares a full bathroom with another bedroom containing a queen-sized bed. The next bedroom on this level features a king-sized bed and ensuite bathroom. Finally, the primary bedroom offers a king-sized bed with an ensuite bathroom. Parking for this home is located in a two-car garage. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 74 Nonesuch Way. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
